'''Ulseh''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], Ulseh was made a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and selected the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]] [[Ren Auglu]] as his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. While he was training Auglu, the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and Master Ulseh took up the rank of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]].<ref name="OTF" />

Dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Argul]], the Master-Padawan pair participated in the [[Battle of Argul|campaign]] there, overseeing the evacuation of the injured [[Argullian]]s while Master [[Nemen Ull]] held back the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]]. When one of the Republic's [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]] was shot down by the Confederacy's artillery, Ulseh went to help the crash survivors escape the wreckage. However, the droid artillery began firing upon the ship again, and Ulseh was [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="OTF" />
